messages:
maria: Heads up — saw a big inbound spike Sat 00:30 PDT. HubSpot enrichment lag ~45m, lots of leads left unassigned. Proposing a temporary auto-backfill play: run an ML-score backfill that marks leads with score >= 0.7 as `priority` and route them to the overflow SDR pool; also update the HS workflow to skip enrichment wait if lead.age > 30m. Thoughts?
ajay: Can we change HS workflow without breaking SF sync? Need the exact HS property name and the SF mapping we'll write to. Also: any risk of duplicating claims? @rina will want a TTL.
rina: If overflow route gets high-score leads that's fine. We need a claim-lock TTL to prevent double-claims. Prefer RR within overflow with small jitter. Also want a dashboard check to validate claims/duplicates.
dan: Eng can spin up a backfill job. ETA ~2h to QA. Need the HS property name and a sample query to select leads. Example SQL I'm thinking to use for the backfill:
```
UPDATE leads
SET auto_score = ml_score
WHERE created_at > now() - interval '7 days' AND auto_score IS NULL;
```
I'll push a staging job once we agree.
tom: Product: we'll standardize on HS property `auto_prior_score` and workflow `AutoBackfillRoute`. Ajay — can you confirm the SF target is `Priority__c` and acceptable enum values?
ajay: Confirming SF mapping -> HS `auto_prior_score` maps to `Priority__c` (High/Medium/Low). We'll translate numeric score to enums: >=0.8 High, 0.7-0.8 Medium, else Low. Also recommend limiting backfill to leads with email or phone to avoid noise.
maria: Plan draft: 1) dan deploy backfill to staging and run sample on 1k leads; 2) ajay toggle HS workflow in dev; 3) rina update overflow RR rules and set claim-lock TTL=10m; 4) monitor claim_success_rate and lead_claim_latency metrics. Canary for 1h then full.
rina: I'll make RR with jitter=30s and dedupe by email. I'll also add a Slack alert to #support if claim_fail_rate > 5%.
deploy-bot: Job scheduled: backfill-job-1719504321 pushed to staging by dan — status: queued.
dan: Opening PR with job + workflow export and note about dedupe. PR: https://github.com/redwood/backfill/pull/512
ajay: Heads-up: be careful with jitter and fairness — if overflow has few reps we could starve others. Recommend overflow only for High category for first 24h.
maria: Good call. Let's limit to High for initial rollout and monitor. I'll plan to run the full change at 8pm PT to avoid business hours. :white_check_mark: @rina can you be on standby?
rina: :thumbsup: I'll standby and verify live claims. Will post a table of claim latencies after 30m.
dan: Deployed to staging, ran sample. No obvious regressions. Pushed PR.
maria: Thanks. I'll update the HubSpot playbook after rollout and add the backfill runbook steps.
[NEXT DAY]
rina: Quick verification: during the surge we saw ~90% of High priority leads claimed within 3m after rollout. One tweak: lower dedupe window from 15m->10m to reduce lost captures. Will update RR.
maria: Excellent — thanks everyone. Follow-up: schedule weekly backfill test and add a dashboard tile for `auto_backfill_success`.
